```{r}
library("GimmeMyOmics")
library("GimmmeMySC")
library("GimmeMyPlot")
library("magrittr")
library("rlist")
library("Seurat")
library("cowplot")
library("kableExtra")
library("openxlsx")

source(
  file.path(file.path(
  dirname(getwd()),
  "inst",
  "extdata"
), "conf.R"))

fc_threshold  <- log2(1.5)
p_threshold <- .05
pct_threshold <- 0.25
exp_threshold <- 0.1

grouping.var <- "Type"
cell_label <- snn_cluster
# cell_label <- "predicted.labels"

pseudo <- TRUE
```

```{r}
load(file.path(path_data, paste0(seurat_dataset, ".rda")))
Idents(seurat) <- snn_cluster
assay <- "RNA" -> assay2
levels(seurat) <- reorder_ident
seurat[[]][, snn_cluster] <- Idents(seurat)

if (assay == "ATAC") {
  func_format <- identity
}
```

```{r}
ids <- data.frame(
```

## Differentially Expressed Genes
```{r}
if (isFALSE(pseudo)) {
  cluster_marker_genes <- dea_sc(seurat, ids, grouping.var = grouping.var, assay = assay2)
  
  l_dea_raw <- cluster_marker_genes %>%
    mutate(gene_name = gene) %>%
    format_dea(fc_threshold = fc_threshold, p_threshold = p_threshold)
  
  l_dea_proc <- dea2deseq(l_dea_raw, pct_threshold = pct_threshold, exp_threshold = exp_threshold)
}
```

# Pseudo-bulk
```{r}
if (isTRUE(pseudo)) {
  library("DESeq2")
  min_exp <- 50
  
  table(Idents(seurat), seurat$Type) %>%
    kable_sc(file = file.path(path_fig, "table_cell_before.png"))
  seurat <- downsample_by_cluster(seurat)
  table(Idents(seurat), seurat$Type) %>%
    kable_sc(file = file.path(path_fig, "table_cell_after.png"))

cts <- AggregateExpression(
  seurat,
  group.by = c(cell_label, "Patient"),
  assay = assay,
  slot = "counts",
  return.seurat = FALSE
)

cts <- pluck(cts, assay) %>%
  as.data.frame()
cts <- list.map(
  levels(seurat@meta.data[, cell_label]),
  f(x) ~{
    select(cts, starts_with(paste0("g", x, "_"))) %>% 
      set_colnames(colnames(.) %>% str_remove_all(paste0("g", x, "_")))
  }
) %>% set_names(levels(seurat@meta.data[, cell_label]))

cell_pct <- pct_by_ident_type(seurat) %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene_name")

metadata_samples <- colnames(cts[[1]]) %>%
    data.frame(id = ., condition = str_remove_all(., "\\d*$") %>% str_remove_all(., "_$")) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), as.factor)) %>%
    column_to_rownames("id")
metadata_samples$condition <- relevel(metadata_samples$condition, ref = "KO")

genome_version <- 113
if (species == "human") {
    genome_species <- "hsapiens"
} else {
  genome_species <- "mmusculus"
}

data("biomart_annotation", package = "GimmeMyOmics")
annotation <- biomart_annotation[[paste(genome_species, genome_version, sep = "_")]]

l_dea_proc <- list.map(
    names(cts),
    f(name_cl) ~{
        gene_count_raw  <- pluck(cts, name_cl) %>%
            rownames_to_column("gene_name")
        
        metadata_genes <- filter(annotation, !duplicated(ensembl_gene_id)) %>%
            left_join(gene_count_raw, ., by = "gene_name") %>%
            select(colnames(annotation))
        
        gene_count <- pluck(cts, name_cl) %>%
            round()
        
if (ncol(gene_count) != nrow(metadata_samples))
          return(NULL)
        dea_df <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
            countData = gene_count,
            colData = metadata_samples,
            design = ~ condition
        ) %>%
            .[rowSums(counts(.) >= min_exp) >= 2, ]
        
        dea <- DESeq(dea_df, quiet = TRUE)
        
        dea_raw <- lfcShrink(
            dea,
            contrast = c(colnames(metadata_samples)[1], levels(pull(metadata_samples, 1))),
            type = "ashr",
            quiet = TRUE
        )
        
        dea_pretty <- format_dea(
            dea_raw,
            metadata_genes,
            fc_threshold = fc_threshold,
            p_threshold = p_threshold,
            name_id = "gene_name"
        ) %>%
            mutate(
                # Expression = ifelse(
                #     gene_name %in% cell_pct$gene_name[cell_pct[[paste0(name_cl, ".WT")]] > pct_threshold] |
                #         gene_name %in% cell_pct$gene_name[cell_pct[[paste0(name_cl, ".KO")]] > pct_threshold],
                #     Expression,
                #     "ns"
                # ),
                gene = gene_name
            )
    }
)
}
```

## Volcano plots
```{r, message = FALSE, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 10}
l_deg <- l_dea_proc %>%
  compact() %>% 
  discard(~ nrow(.x) == 0) %>% 
  set_names(names(.) %>% inverser_vs())
kable_dea(l_deg, file = file.path(path_fig, "table_dea.png"))

l_deg_top <- list.map(
  l_deg,
  f(x) ~ top_genes(
    x,
    fc_threshold = fc_threshold,
    p_threshold = p_threshold,
      n = Inf,
      return_rank  = TRUE
    ) %>% atac2gene(seurat, .)
) %>% 
  compact()

volcano_plot_custom <- function(l_deg_top) {
  
  l_deg_top <- list.map(l_deg_top, head(., 15))

  p <- list.map(
    l_deg_top,
    f(i, j, k) ~ {
        volcano_plot(
          l_deg[[k]], 
          title = k,
          top_genes = i, 
          fc_threshold = fc_threshold,
          cex = 0.75, 
          cex_genes = 4,
          p_threshold = p_threshold,
          max.overlaps = 1e3,
          force = 1e2
        ) + 
        labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = k) +
        theme(legend.position = "none")
    })
  
  n <- length(p)
  if (n < 6) {
    seq_n <- seq(n)
  } else {
    seq_n <- seq(ceiling(n/2))
    plot_grid(plotlist = p[(ceiling(n/2) + 1):n], align = "hv", nrow = 2) %>% plot()
  }
  plot_grid(plotlist = p[seq_n], align = "hv", nrow = 2)
}

volcano_plot_custom(l_deg_top)

list.map(l_deg_top, filter(., log2FoldChange > 0)) %>% 
  discard(~ nrow(.x) == 0) %>%
  volcano_plot_custom()

list.map(l_deg_top, ~ filter(., log2FoldChange < 0)) %>%
  discard(~ nrow(.x) == 0) %>%
  volcano_plot_custom()
```

# Save DEG
```{r}
l_deg2 <- list.map(
    l_deg,
    f(x) ~ {
      if (!pseudo) {
        x <- mutate(x, description = "")
      }
      res <- print_dea(x, metadata = TRUE, f = desc, rank_by = "rank_fc", return_rank = TRUE)
      if (nrow(res) == 0) return(NULL)
      if (assay == "ATAC") {
        res <- rename(res, gene_name = Gene) %>%
          atac2gene(seurat, .) %>%
          mutate(Position = gene) %>%
          rename(Gene = gene_name)
      }
        mutate(res, Expression = if_else(`Fold-change` > 0, "up", "down")) %>%
        split(.$Expression)
    }
) %>%
  compact() %>%
    # set_names(names(l_deg)) %>%
    list_flatten(name_spec = "{outer}_{inner}")

omics2excel(
  l_deg2,
    file = file.path(path_fig, "deg.xlsx"),
    function(x) {
      res <- select(x, -c("Expression", "gene"))
      if (!pseudo)
        select(res, -c("Full name", "pval")) %>% 
        rename_with(
            ~ case_when(
                 . == "ensembl_gene_id" ~ "Ensembl ID",
                str_detect(., "^pct\\.\\d+$") ~ str_replace(., "^pct\\.(\\d+)$", "%Cell (\\1)"),
                str_detect(., "^exp\\.\\d+$") ~ str_replace(., "^exp\\.(\\d+)$", "Gene expression (\\1)"),
                TRUE ~ .
            )
        )
      else
        res
    }
)

if (isFALSE(pseudo))
omics2excel(
  l_deg2,
  file = file.path(path_fig, "marker_cluster.xlsx"),
  function(x) {
    x %>%
    select(-c(c("ensembl_gene_id", "Full name", "gene"), contains(c("KO_", "WT_", "val")))) %>%
    rename(
      `avg_log2FC` = "Fold-change",
      p_val_adj = "P-adjusted"
    ) %>%
    select(-contains("exp."))
  }
)
```

## Dotplots
```{r}
l_deg_top_all <- list.map(
  l_deg_top_all,
  f(x)~ {
  if (assay == "ATAC") {
    mutate(
      x,
      gene_name2 = gene_name,
      gene_name = gene,
      gene = gene_name2
    )
  } else  x
})

top50 <- list.map(
    l_deg_top_all,  
    f(x, xx, xxx) ~head(x, 50) %>%
        mutate(cluster = factor(xxx, levels = unique(names(l_deg_top_all))))) %>%
    list.rbind()

top5_filtered <- top50 %>%
    filter(!duplicated(gene)) %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    slice_head(n = 5) %>%
    ungroup()
```
